submitted.rationale: XRD shows a rutile/trirutile (CoSb2O6-type) phase across the whole line, plus extra Sb-oxide peaks on the Sb-rich side (index 26). EQE rose as Sb increased: index 10 gave -0.026%, index 20 gave -0.009%, and index 27 gave +0.009%. Index 27 is the only measured composition with a positive EQE, so it is the best of those measured.
